title: Independence Day | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Pet-friendly Seaside retreat near Ruskin Beach and pools, with bikes, screened balcony, spacious yard, and walkable access to dining, shopping, and fun.
description_expanded: Independence Day Features - 1 Minute bike ride to W Ruskin Beach Entrance, access included with your reservation - Pet friendly for up to 2 dogs, 50 pounds or under. Must get approval from Exclusive 30A and pay a non-refundable pet fee. Any unauthorized pets will result in fines and possible eviction. - Home is around the corner from the Lyceum Lawn and the middle of Seaside with lots of shopping and dining options - 150 Yards to the West Side Pool, with towel service and heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Parking for 2 vehicles. Parking is first come, first serve in the parallel spots in front of home and throughout neighborhood - Complimentary Use of 3 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to ensure they are ready for adventures whenever you are - Full Kitchen on the 2nd floor with stainless steel appliances plus a Keurig and Drip Coffee Maker - Dining area on the 2nd floor with seating for 8 plus breakfast nook seating for 4 - Main living area on the 2nd floor with Smart TV - Workspace with desk and chair on the 2nd floor - Screened-in Balcony off the main living area with outdoor dining for 4 plus cushioned seating set - 1st Floor Patio with seating - Landscaped yard with Adirondack seating plus large circular lounge chair - Enclosed outdoor shower - Outdoor charcoal grill - WIFI throughout the home. Cable in the main living area - Washer and Dryer available in the home - Access to 3 swimming pools, 5 Clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 Pickle ball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness center. Pools are heated during cooler months and offer towel service (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Seaside HOA may provide medical exceptions on a limited basis. - Concierge services available, including grocery delivery, baby equipment rentals, beach bonfire setup, and more! - Beach Service available through Cabana Man. We recommend you reserve chairs as soon as possible to ensure availability for your stay. Exclusive 30A will provide you an access code once your rental reservation is confirmed. - Rooftop access not available for guests - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to your coastal oasis! Nestled in the famous Seaside community, this delightful 3-suite home offers the perfect blend of comfort and coastal living. You will love this classic Seaside vacation experience! The heart of the home is the spacious living room, where you can relax after a day of coastal adventures. Adjacent is the full kitchen, complete with modern appliances and ample counter space, ideal for whipping up delicious meals with fresh, local ingredients. Venture outside to discover the treasures of this property. Whether you're looking to soak up the sun or enjoy the sea breeze, you'll find the perfect spot in the expansive yard, complete with a large open-air patio and nearby outdoor grill. Perfect for al fresco dining or evening gatherings under the stars, this outdoor space is sure to become a favorite hangout spot. For those seeking a bit of shade, retreat to the large screened-in balcony, where you can unwind with a good book or simply savor the tranquil surroundings. And for exploring the area, take advantage of the bicycles provided, allowing you to easily cruise along the coastal paths and explore all that Seaside living has to offer. With its charming ambiance, convenient amenities, and prime location, this 3-suite home is the ultimate coastal retreat, promising a memorable and rejuvenating getaway for you and your loved ones. Welcome home to Independence Day! ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
